text:
Alex Rivera: Heads up — planning a Belonging Day mini-grants pop-up next Wed (3/31). Need a spot-award table, ~100 sticker packs, and printed spot-award cards. Budget approved up to $1.2k. Who can pick up swag from the vendor warehouse on Mon?
Jamie Cho: I can pick up in the AM, I have a car. What address and time?
Alex Rivera: Vendor is Eastside Logistics (432 Harbor Rd). Aim for pickup 9–10am. @Maria can you confirm sticker pack count and table qty? We also need 2 folding chairs.
Maria Patel: Confirmed — we ordered 120 sticker packs and 2 folding tables. Delivery shows "warehouse ready" Mon. I'll DM the tracking. +1 to @Jamie for pickup. Also: who can print 150 spot-award cards?
Taylor Nguyen: I can print 150 cards at the office printer and collate them. Where should the copy live?
Alex Rivera: Use this copy for the card:

```
Thank you for making Redwood better — this spot award is for your outstanding contribution.
Please write a quick note on the back and drop in the recognition box. — People Ops
```

Also: short URL for the nomination form: https://redwood.internal/nominate (share with volunteers).
Riley (people-ops-bot): Reminder: Expense policy — all spenders must submit an expense report within 7 days of pickup. Link: https://redwood.internal/expenses :bell:
Jamie Cho: Sounds good. I'll message the vendor to confirm loading dock access. Anyone with a hand truck to help unload?
Maria Patel: Can we add 30 branded tote bags to the pickup? Small cost bump but useful for giveaways. Approve?
Alex Rivera: @Taylor approved for totes up to $150. Add to the pickup manifest.
Taylor Nguyen: Added totes and printed card mockup. Pickup scheduled Mon 9:15am. My cell is 555-0199 if vendor needs to call.
Alex Rivera: Volunteer coverage plan: setup Wed 8:00am, pop-up 10:00–2:00. Volunteers confirmed: @Alex, @Jamie, @Maria, @Taylor. Need someone to cover lunch shift 12–1 so I can join exec sync.
Jamie Cho: I can cover 12–1.
Maria Patel: I'll be there 8–11:30. @Riley (people-ops-bot) can you create a calendar event for volunteers and include the packing checklist?
Riley (people-ops-bot): Event created: "Belonging Day Pop-up" Wed 8:00–14:00. Volunteers: Alex Rivera, Jamie Cho, Maria Patel, Taylor Nguyen. Packing checklist attached in event. RSVP link: https://calendar.redwood/event/12345
Alex Rivera: Perfect — I'll post a short reminder Monday 7:00am. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Jamie Cho: Great - see you all Wed. :sparkles:
